question: Recipient of President's Medal For Distinguished Service (PSM) on the occasion of Republic Day 2025, Shri Deepak Kumar Kedia belongs to which of the following organisations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Security Guard (NSG)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shri Deepak Kumar Kedia** was awarded the **President's Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM)** on the occasion of Republic Day 2025. This prestigious honor is given to individuals who display exemplary service and commitment to their duties.
 
• Shri Deepak Kumar Kedia is associated with the **National Security Guard (NSG)**, a premier counter-terrorism and special operations force in India.
 
• The **National Security Guard (NSG)** was established in **1984** under the National Security Guard Act, 1986. It is a federal contingency force tasked with combating terrorism and safeguarding national security.
